scenes.text: A Conda environment keeps spaCR and its scientific dependencies separate from unrelated projects. Python three point twelve currently offers the broadest optional-package compatibility.
scenes.speech_text: A Conda environment keeps spacer and its scientific dependencies separate from unrelated projects. Python three point twelve currently offers the broadest optional-package compatibility.

scenes.text: Open a Conda-enabled terminal and create an environment named spacr with Python three point twelve and pip.
